pattern.description: A lone AI sparkle in the centre bursts outward into floating gradient spheres while the camera pushes in; the title 'Introducing Loom AI' then fades up word by word, with the sparkle settling as a superscript accent after 'AI'.
pattern.why_premium: The sparkle is a single hero object that both seeds the spheres (motion origin) and ends as the brand accent, so the opening reads as one continuous gesture; word-by-word reveal is timed to the music hits, and depth comes from sphere blur and parallax rather than flat slides.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.sparkle',{x:0,scale:1.4},{x:sparkleEndX,scale:0.6,duration:0.8,ease:'power3.out'}); tl.fromTo('.sphere',{x:0,y:0,scale:0.3},{x:(i)=>dx[i],y:(i)=>dy[i],scale:1,duration:0.9,ease:'power3.out',stagger:0.04},0); tl.fromTo('.cam',{scale:1},{scale:1.02,duration:1.2,ease:'sine.out'},0); tl.fromTo('.title .word',{opacity:0,scale:0.96},{opacity:1,scale:1,duration:0.3,ease:'power2.out',stagger:0.23},0.4); last word 'AI' stays at reduced opacity.
build_hint.remotion: Sparkle and spheres: spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:22, stiffness:120, mass:1}}) driving interpolate() for x/y/scale from centre to end positions, sphere i delayed by ~1 frame each. Words: per-word spring (no overshoot, damping ~26) delayed ~7 frames apart mapped to opacity 0→1 and scale 0.96→1. Wrap scene in a container with interpolate(frame,[0,36],[1,1.02]) for the push-in.

notes: Sparkle travel from frame centre to after 'AI' is inferred from filmstrip continuity (b08 is its end box). Sphere motion is a mix of object motion and the measured camera push_in; directions per sphere are approximate. 'AI' renders at lower opacity in the end frame (OCR reads 'Al'). All SFX candidates left unsure: the stem shows evenly spaced broadband streaks that look like music percussion.
